texts.title: When structure is only an impression
paragraphs: P1

A fashion editor describes a close-fitting white dress as “structured”, pointing to its high neckline and angular panels. Yet a photograph alone cannot establish how firmly the fabric holds its shape: a soft garment stretched over the body can produce a similarly crisp outline. The editor’s description is therefore a reading of the visible design, rather than a measurement of the textile.
P2

This distinction does not make the description useless. Silhouette describes the outline a viewer perceives; construction concerns the means by which that outline is produced. A garment may look sharply defined because of its cut, its internal support, its fit, or the model’s posture. Treating any one of these possible causes as certain would exceed the available evidence.
P3

The same caution applies to the silver boots beside the dress. Their reflective finish supports the description “metallic”, but it does not establish that their surface is solid metal. Precise fashion writing can remain vivid while separating what an image shows from what an observer merely supposes.

texts.title: Why a restricted palette can feel complex
paragraphs: P1

At first glance, a white dress, a pale blue capelet and silver boots offer little colour variation. An editor might therefore expect the outfit to look uniform. That expectation assumes that colour does most of the work of distinguishing one surface from another. In this outfit, however, light behaves differently at each surface: the capelet admits some light, the boots return sharp reflections, and the dress presents a more continuous visual plane.
P2

The capelet also leaves parts of the body visible. It can therefore soften the boundary around the shoulders without adding the visual weight of a similarly sized opaque coat. This does not mean that transparent layers always make a silhouette lighter. A dense arrangement of folds or several overlapping layers could have the opposite effect.
P3

The outfit’s coherence lies in the relationship among its surfaces, rather than in their being identical. A shared pale palette holds the pieces together, while differences in translucency and reflection keep them distinct. Removing those differences might make the colours easier to match, but could also remove the contrast on which the composition depends.

texts.title: Denim and the manufacture of age
paragraphs: P1

Two denim jackets may appear equally worn while arriving at that appearance through very different processes. One may have faded gradually through use; the other may have acquired pale areas during production. Calling both surfaces “washed” can describe a visible effect, but cannot by itself reconstruct either garment’s history. Appearance and provenance answer different questions.
P2

The distinction matters when describing a deliberately distressed collection. A pale patch is not necessarily a hole, and a frayed edge does not establish that a garment is old. Designers can produce both effects on new fabric. Such interventions may invoke the associations of wear without requiring the practical damage or long use with which those associations originated.
P3

This is not a reason to regard manufactured wear as inherently deceptive. A collection may openly present distressing as a design technique. The stronger criticism would concern a specific unsupported claim—for example, that a newly treated jacket had actually been worn for decades. An assessment of that claim would require evidence of the garment’s history, not simply a judgement about how convincingly its surface imitates age.

texts.title: The short jacket and the wide trouser
paragraphs: P1

An oversized denim jacket need not make the entire upper body appear expansive. In one styling study, the shoulders are broad but the hem ends above the waist. Below it, wide trousers carry most of the outfit’s volume. Describing the jacket only as “large” misses the relation between these two dimensions: width increases at the shoulder while length is curtailed.
P2

Curved seams provide another organising device. They guide the eye down the trouser legs, linking separate panels into a continuous visual movement. Metal fastenings create local accents, but their prominence should not be confused with responsibility for the overall proportion. A small bright buckle may attract attention without determining the relative lengths of the upper and lower parts.
P3

Suppose the jacket were lengthened while its shoulders and the trousers remained unchanged. The outfit might still be recognisably oversized, yet its balance would alter because more of the upper region would be covered. A stylist’s useful task is therefore not simply to name each piece, but to explain how a change in one part affects the reading of the whole.

texts.title: A surface that belongs to the scene
paragraphs: P1

A lilac dress appears against blue-and-pink glass in a fashion illustration. Because the glass shifts in colour across the scene, a viewer describes the entire look as iridescent. That description may capture the atmosphere, but it obscures an important question: which part of the image actually displays the effect? The background’s colour changes do not establish that the dress would change colour as its viewing angle changed.
P2

The dress is more securely described through its draped folds and unequal hem. These features contribute to a fluid outline, while a sheer sleeve leaves the arm partly visible. Metallic platform sandals add a contrasting sense of solidity below. None of these observations requires the dress itself to possess every optical property suggested by the surrounding scene.
P3

An editor could deliberately use the coloured glass to extend the outfit’s mood beyond the garment. The scene would then function as an interpretive frame rather than as a textile specification. To evaluate the claim that the dress is physically iridescent, however, one would need evidence that distinguishes a property of its surface from the effects of coloured light, illustration or background design.

texts.title: A revival without a replica
paragraphs: P1

A collection invokes the early digital era through three markedly different looks: a sharply outlined white dress, a washed-denim ensemble and a lilac draped outfit. A critic objects that the colours and silhouettes are too varied to form a coherent revival. The objection treats fidelity to a single appearance as the test of a shared historical reference.
P2

An alternative account locates the connection at the level of a recurring idea: imagining a future through visual languages associated with the past. The white dress suggests a controlled, geometric future; the denim ensemble introduces the personal traces of use; the lilac outfit offers movement and softness. Their differences need not be defects in the collection. They can be the means through which its shared question is explored.
P3

This argument does not establish that the designs are historically exact. Revival names a return of interest in an earlier style, whereas nostalgia describes an attitude toward the past. Neither term guarantees that every new garment reproduces an actual period example. A convincing account of the collection should therefore explain the relationship among its interpretations without inventing a single original outfit from which all three supposedly descend.

questions.answer: A distinction between renewed stylistic interest and a feeling toward the past
notes: Prices do not enter the argument.
Revival concerns returning interest; nostalgia concerns an attitude or feeling.
The passage’s distinction is conceptual rather than technological.
Neither colours nor silhouettes are graded for accuracy in this way.

questions.prompt: Which finding would most weaken the critic’s stated objection?
options: The three outfits were shown consecutively in the presentation.
The designer used different fabrics for each of the outfits.
The outfits received different responses from different viewers.
A clear account shows how the different looks each develop the same underlying idea.
questions.answer: A clear account shows how the different looks each develop the same underlying idea.
notes: Sequence alone does not establish a shared interpretive relation.
Different fabrics repeat the variation to which the critic objects.
Different responses do not directly establish thematic coherence.
A demonstrated common idea challenges the assumption that visual similarity is necessary.

questions.prompt: The qualification “does not establish that the designs are historically exact” prevents which inference?
options: A coherent reinterpretation must also be an exact reproduction of period clothing.
Different interpretations can address the same question.
A collection can invoke visual languages associated with the past.
Revival and nostalgia are useful but distinct concepts.
questions.answer: A coherent reinterpretation must also be an exact reproduction of period clothing.
notes: The author separates thematic coherence from exact historical reproduction.
That is part of the argument, not an inference being blocked.
The passage expressly accepts such an invocation.
The distinction remains central after the qualification.

questions.prompt: Which proposed description best fits the author’s argument?
options: Three identical period outfits preserved in different materials
Three incompatible styles whose historical references cancel each other
Three contemporary responses to a shared idea of the remembered future
Three proofs that nostalgic fashion requires no changes to original designs
questions.answer: Three contemporary responses to a shared idea of the remembered future
notes: The designs differ and are not established as period originals.
The author argues that variation can contribute to coherence.
This formulation connects the shared theme with the distinct new interpretations.
The passage allows transformation rather than requiring unchanged originals.

levels.title_zh: 编辑终考 · 三种未来

economy.replay: 只保留各关最佳正确数；XP按最佳成绩差额补发。
economy.mastery: 单词页可查看学习状态；“题中答对”只表示关联题曾独立答对，不宣称长期掌握。
economy.item_practice: 12道单品随堂练习，答后解释，可重复，不加XP或星级；36道关卡题沿用原计分。

extension_words.example: A cropped jacket ends above the waist.
extension_words.translation: 短款夹克在腰线上方结束。

extension_words.example: The waistband sits across the hips.
Wide-leg trousers add volume below the waist.
extension_words.translation: 阔腿裤在腰部以下增加体积。

extension_words.example: The platform sole adds height below the foot.
One side of the hem is longer.
The high neckline frames the neck.
The open knit sleeve has visible gaps.
extension_words.translation: 镂空针织袖有可见空隙。

items.reference_scope_zh: 参考2024秋冬系列的包裹轮廓；重设衣长、领口和分割线。
items.body_en: The fitted mini dress creates a narrow silhouette. Its high neckline and geometric panels give the bodice a structured appearance. Fitted describes how closely it follows the body; structured describes how clearly the shape is held.
items.body_zh: 贴体短裙构成窄长廓形，高领与几何拼片让衣身呈现明确结构。fitted 强调贴体程度，structured 强调保形的结构感。
items.focus_zh: 先看全身外轮廓，再看领口和拼片；不要把“贴身”与“有结构”当成同义词。

items.reference_scope_zh: 肩罩为原创外层，增加几何边缘与轻薄层次。
items.body_en: The translucent capelet lets light pass through, so the arms remain partly visible. Its light texture contrasts with the solid-looking boots. Here, contrast comes from different surface effects rather than strongly different colours.
items.body_zh: 半透明肩罩让光线穿过，手臂仍部分可见。轻薄质感与靴子较实的表面形成对比；这里的 contrast 来自表面效果，而非强烈色差。
items.focus_zh: 看肩罩与手臂重叠的位置，观察透光与不透光的差别。

items.reference_scope_zh: 参考修长靴筒比例；银色、方头和跟型重新设计。
items.body_en: The metallic boots reflect light from a smooth surface. Their long shafts extend the silhouette below the short dress. Metallic describes a visual finish; it does not mean the entire boot is made from solid metal.
items.body_zh: 金属光泽长靴从光滑表面反光，长靴筒延伸了短裙下方的廓形。metallic 描述视觉表面，不等于整只靴子由实心金属制成。
items.focus_zh: 观察靴筒上的亮暗条带，与肩罩的透光作对比。

items.reference_scope_zh: 月牙包及发饰为原创几何配件。
items.body_en: The small bag repeats the curved lines of the outfit without adding a large new shape. Its metallic surface connects it to the boots. Repetition can hold a look together, while a contrast in texture keeps the pieces from becoming identical.
items.body_zh: 小包重复整套的弧线，不新增大体积；金属光泽与长靴呼应。重复可以让造型统一，而质感对比让各件不至于完全相同。
items.focus_zh: 看小包与长靴的相似表面，再比较包与肩罩的差别。

items.reference_scope_zh: 参考2024秋冬洗水丹宁与宽肩语言；长外层改为短款并重画拼片。
items.body_en: The cropped denim jacket has oversized shoulders and a washed finish. Pale areas describe the surface treatment. A distressed effect can suggest wear, but washed denim does not necessarily have a frayed edge: frayed specifically means loose threads along an edge.
items.body_zh: 短丹宁夹克采用宽肩和洗水表面，浅色区域体现处理效果。distressed 可以表示做旧，但 washed 不一定带 frayed 毛边；frayed 特指边缘松散的线头。
items.focus_zh: 本图重点是深浅洗水与肩部体积，不把浅色区域说成破洞，也不凭空描述毛边。

items.name_en: Wide-leg trousers with an angled waistband
items.reference_scope_zh: 参考丹宁套装，新增斜腰头与弧形裤腿分割。
items.body_en: The wide-leg trousers carry more volume than the short jacket. An angled waistband and curved seams guide the eye across the hips and down the legs. The buckle is hardware: a small metal fastening, not a type of fabric.
items.body_zh: 阔腿裤承担比短夹克更大的体积。斜腰头与弧形接缝引导视线经过胯部并向下移动；buckle 是 hardware 金属配件，不是一种布料。
items.focus_zh: 从腰头一路看向裤脚，跟随弧形接缝理解版型。

items.name_en: Fitted lilac vest with lime trim
items.reference_scope_zh: 背心为原创内层，用轻薄色块平衡重丹宁。
items.body_en: The fitted vest sits close to the body under the oversized jacket. This layered outfit uses a small, bright inner piece to balance the heavier denim. The contrast is about fit, colour and texture at the same time.
items.body_zh: 贴体背心位于宽大夹克内侧。层叠造型用小而明亮的内层平衡较重的丹宁，同时在贴合度、颜色与肌理上形成对比。
items.focus_zh: 比较背心与夹克的宽窄，理解 layered 不只是“多穿一件”。

items.reference_scope_zh: 鞋履为原创方头厚底；播放器同为原创道具。
items.body_en: A thick platform sole gives the shoes visual weight below the wide trousers. The metallic toe area echoes the outfit’s hardware. The sole belongs to the shoe’s structure, while metallic describes a surface effect.
items.body_zh: 厚底在阔腿裤下方增加视觉重量，鞋头金属光泽呼应服装配件。sole 属于鞋的结构，metallic 则描述表面效果。
items.focus_zh: 把“厚底的形状”与“银色反光的表面”分开描述。

items.reference_scope_zh: 参考2023春夏流动轮廓；紫色、单侧袖与短裙比例重新设计。
items.body_en: The lilac dress is draped around the body, and its asymmetric hem extends on one side. The fabric looks fluid because the folds continue into a moving tail. The short front and longer side create a deliberate proportion rather than a cutting mistake.
items.body_zh: 淡紫裙以垂褶围绕身体，不对称下摆在一侧延长。褶皱延伸成流动裙尾；前短侧长是有意的比例设计，并非裁剪失误。
items.focus_zh: 顺着腰部褶皱看到侧边裙尾，再比较左右长度。

items.name_en: Sheer sleeve and open-knit arm layer
items.reference_scope_zh: 薄纱与镂空语言来自系列研究；独立袖套为重新组合。
items.body_en: One arm is covered by a sheer sleeve; the other uses an open knit layer with visible gaps. Both reveal part of the arm, but their textures are different. Sheer describes the transparent effect, while knit names a textile construction.
items.body_zh: 一侧手臂覆轻薄透视袖，另一侧是带可见空隙的镂空针织层。两者都露出部分手臂，肌理却不同；sheer 描述透视效果，knit 指针织结构。
items.focus_zh: 看两侧袖层怎样露出手臂，不把所有透视面料都叫针织。

items.reference_scope_zh: 凉鞋的厚底、踝带与色彩为原创设计。
items.body_en: The metallic sandals add a firm base below the fluid skirt. Their platform soles change the proportion of the lower body, while the narrow straps leave the feet visible. The contrast between heavy soles and light fabric is a design choice.
items.body_zh: 金属光泽凉鞋在流动裙摆下形成稳定基座，厚底改变下半身比例，细带露出脚部。重鞋底与轻布料的对比是一种设计选择。
items.focus_zh: 比较脚下厚底的重量感与身侧薄纱的轻盈。

items.name_en: Silver mini bag and double-bun hairstyle
items.reference_scope_zh: 小包、发髻和发饰为原创；不作为品牌原款或历史穿着记录。
items.body_en: The small silver bag and playful hair styling can suggest nostalgia, but they do not prove a date. A revival means a style returns to popularity; nostalgia is a feeling about the past. The background has an iridescent effect, but the silver bag is described here only as metallic.
items.body_zh: 银色小包与活泼发型可以暗示怀旧，却不能证明年代。revival 是风格重新流行，nostalgia 是对过去的感受。背景有虹彩效果，这只银包在这里仅描述为 metallic 金属光泽。
items.focus_zh: 观察包、发饰与背景，区分情绪联想、趋势变化和真实可见的表面。
